verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a customer data platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Segment's hosted workspace, APIs, Functions and storage destinations, with no documented self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core product. Sending data to your own warehouse or S3 is an adjacent data-export feature, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
